from pathlib import Path
import json,base64,io,tarfile,hashlib
a=json.loads(Path('evd-045-v2.json').read_bytes())['archive']; parts=[]
for name in a['parts']:
    o=json.loads(Path(name).read_bytes()); b=base64.b64decode(o['data'],validate=True); assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==o['sha256']; parts.append(b)
b=b''.join(parts); assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==a['sha256']
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(b),mode='r:gz') as t:
    for name,h in json.load(t.extractfile('archive-file-digests.json')).items():
        p=Path('evd-045-raw')/name; assert p.resolve().is_relative_to(Path('evd-045-raw').resolve()); b=t.extractfile(name).read(); assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==h; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_bytes(b)
